description: Offline classroom whiteboard with infinite canvas, PDF markup, notes, and cross-device sync.
notes: Uses the official NSIS Setup instead of the Portable EXE, which extracts into Windows TEMP. Setup creates Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts; its uninstaller removes them.

Requires a Scoop root path without spaces. This electron-builder 25.1.8 Setup truncates an unquoted /D= path at the first space; quoting /D= caused this build to fail. A path such as D:\Scoop is compatible.
The desktop app stores its vault and sync configuration in Electron's userData directory under %APPDATA%, outside the Scoop version directory. Scoop does not redirect this data to persist.
The repository README and root LICENSE.txt state MIT, but desktop/package.json declares Proprietary; this upstream license-metadata discrepancy remains unresolved.
